'''Mooney''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who worked for another [[Unidentified bounty hunter (Mooney)|bounty hunter]] around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]]. At some point in his life, he attempted to capture the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and his master [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] in [[Death Canyon]].
